_comment: Copy this file to morning-summary-config.json (same Config/ folder in Scriptable's iCloud Drive). token + chatId are required; the rest are optional overrides.
_comment_calendars: Calendars to read, in display order. Keep "Rooster" to get school-timetable grouping. Remove this key to use the built-in default list.
_comment_thresh: Advice thresholds. aqi = European AQI band (>=60 poor) that triggers an air-quality flag.
_comment_countdowns: Key dates surfaced as 'N days until X' (nearest upcoming shown). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
_comment_quotes: Quote-of-the-day pool; rotates daily. Remove to use the built-in defaults.
quotes: Discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now.
A clean cut starts with a steady hand.
